datasetDef: OpenNeuro ds004504 (CC0, DOI 10.18112/openneuro.ds004504.v1.0.9; Miltiadous et al., Data 2023): resting-state eyes-closed clinical EEG, 36 Alzheimer's / 23 frontotemporal dementia / 29 controls, 19 channels @ 500 Hz, ~12-14 min/subject; curators' preprocessed derivatives (0.5-45 Hz, A1-A2 reref, ASR, ICA artifact rejection). First REAL-MODALITY data in NOESIS. Classification is a sanity check that the spectral representation carries the established EEG-slowing signal in dementia — NOT a diagnostic tool, and scalp EEG maps to no atlas region (disorder-level only, decision #8).
preprocessing: One vector per subject: Welch PSD (4 s windows) over the full cleaned recording; relative band power (delta/theta/alpha/beta/gamma over 0.5-45 Hz total) averaged within 5 scalp zones (frontal/central/temporal/parietal/occipital) = 25 features. Subject-level split is structural: each subject contributes exactly one vector, held out whole in LOSO.
model: StandardScaler + L2 logistic regression (scikit-learn), leave-one-subject-out CV, ROC-AUC on pooled held-out predictions. Significance: 1000 label permutations refitting the full LOSO loop (p = (1+#perm>=observed)/(1+N)); subject-bootstrap 95% CI (2000 resamples). AD-vs-CN primary; FTD-vs-CN secondary.
